items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Because he copied a guy called Bob Sylvester. I remember that. Yeah, you remember him as a saxophone player.

ctx.x: See, that's what I used to like about Glenn Gray's band, Catanova band. He'll get everybody, he'll buy arrangements from you. He'll buy arrangements from me, arrangements from you. Well, my arrangements and your arrangements are different. See, but all this one guy, he'll buy arrangements from me. Like, you give him a number to copy for you. You're going to hear your number played somewhere else before you get it. Because he copied a guy called Bob Sylvester. I remember that. Yeah, you remember him as a saxophone…
Well, when I first asked you about the different bases, first of all, what about aluminum bases? Did you ever try one of those?
